# The Dollar Street Dataset

## Image and video assets
The visual assets of this dataset are in the assets folder.

## Metadata Information
The `images_v2.csv` file contains all the information referenced in the _The Dollar Street Dataset: Images Representing the Geographic and Socioeconomic Diversity of the World_ [paper.](https://openreview.net/forum?id=qnfYsave0U4)

## Dataset Splits
1. Training Dataset
The `images_v2_imagenet_train.csv` file contains the training data used the experiments mentioned in our paper.

2. Test Dataset
The `images_v2_imagenet_test.csv` file contains the test data used the experiments mentioned in our paper.

## Imagenet classes
The `topics_to_imagenet_classes_map.json` file contains the results of our fuzzy mapping of classes in the Dollarstreet Dataset to the ImageNet dataset classes.
